anti_collapse_rules.statistics_not_local_truth: Area percentages represent broad-scale classification summaries. Do not infer parcel, field, farm, person, facility, water-right, crop-loss, or emergency conditions from these statistics.

anti_collapse_rules.release_linkage: Statistics artifact and polygon artifact from the same release week share a deterministic release identity but retain distinct artifact identities, formats, digests, and validation paths.
